items.name: HIT
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you hit someone for under 10 damage (the light hitsound) - very short, < 0.2 s

items.name: KILL
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you killed someone - < 0.6 s

items.name: HURT
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you took damage - < 0.3 s

items.name: STEP
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a footstep (yours and others', in 3D) - very short, < 0.15 s

items.name: JUMP
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a jump - < 0.2 s

items.name: LAND
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: landing from a fall - < 0.3 s

items.name: RIFLE
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: rifle shot - < 0.3 s (automatic: many per second)

items.name: ROCKET
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: rocket launcher fired - < 0.7 s

items.name: KNIFE
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: knife swing / throw - < 0.35 s

items.name: SNIPER
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: sniper shot - < 1 s

items.name: LASER
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: laser (lightning gun), repeats while firing - very short, < 0.1 s

items.name: SHOTGUN
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: shotgun blast - < 0.6 s

items.name: STICKY
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: sticky bomb launched - < 0.4 s

items.name: CROSSBOW
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: crossbow bolt fired - < 0.5 s

items.name: BUBBLE
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: bubble gun shot - < 0.3 s

items.name: SYRINGE
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: syringe used / thrown - < 0.4 s

items.name: EXPLOSION
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a rocket / sticky explodes (3D) - < 1 s

items.name: STICKY_ATTACH
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a sticky bomb sticks to something - < 0.2 s

items.name: BOLT_HIT
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a crossbow bolt hits - < 0.3 s

items.name: DASH
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: dash - < 0.4 s

items.name: GRAPPLE_FIRE
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: grappling hook fired - < 0.3 s

items.name: GRAPPLE_HIT
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: grappling hook catches - < 0.3 s

items.name: DEATH
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you died - < 0.7 s

items.name: STREAK
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: someone else's killstreak - < 0.6 s

items.name: TYPING
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: someone typing in chat (one key click) - very short, < 0.06 s

items.name: CHECKPOINT
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: race: you passed a checkpoint - < 0.35 s

items.name: FINISH
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: race: you crossed the finish - < 0.8 s

items.name: HIT_MED
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you hit someone for 10 to 24 damage (the medium hitsound: heavier and louder than HIT) - short, < 0.25 s

items.name: HIT_HEAVY
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you hit someone for 25 to 50 damage (the heavy hitsound) - < 0.35 s

items.name: HIT_BRUTAL
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you hit someone for more than 50 damage (the brutal hitsound: the heaviest, loudest) - < 0.5 s

items.name: SUPER
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you did a super: a dash jump - < 0.4 s

items.name: HYPER
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you did a hyper: a super dash - < 0.5 s

items.name: LOCATOR
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you used the locator (hide and seek / tag): a sonar-like ping - < 0.9 s

items.name: SIZZLE
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a shot gone into lava or acid, and you while acid hurts you: a hiss - < 0.6 s

items.name: HEADSHOT_TINK
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: your hit was a headshot: a metallic tink over the hitsound - very short, < 0.2 s

items.name: HOOKED
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: someone's grapple caught you and pulls you - < 0.45 s

items.name: BOMB_TICK
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: the planted bomb ticks (3D), faster as its fuse runs out - very short, < 0.1 s

items.name: BOMB_PLANTING
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: bomb: someone planting (3D, at them), one click every 0.3 s while they do - very short, < 0.1 s

items.name: BOMB_DEFUSING
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: bomb: someone defusing (3D, at the bomb), one click every 0.3 s while they do - very short, < 0.12 s

items.name: HILL_CONTESTED
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: king of the hill: the hill became contested (both teams on it) - < 0.5 s

items.name: CAPTURE_ALARM
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: multi point: the enemy is capturing your point (as it starts, then every 3 s) - < 0.75 s

items.name: HOLDFIRE_TICK
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: the map's holdfire (no firing at the round start): a tick each second, higher and louder as firing is allowed - very short, < 0.1 s

items.name: CHECKPOINT_WRONG
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: race: a checkpoint that won't count (out of order, or a run that doesn't count): a buzz - < 0.4 s

items.name: WEAPON_SWITCH
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you switched weapons: two small mechanical clicks - very short, < 0.15 s

items.name: DRYFIRE
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: fire pressed with nothing to fire (holdfire, a thrown knife / syringe not back, the locator's wait): a dry click - very short, < 0.1 s

items.name: KNIFE_HIT
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a thrown knife or syringe lands (3D; the syringe higher) - < 0.2 s

items.name: BUBBLE_POP
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a bubble pops (3D) - short, < 0.15 s

items.name: GLASS_BREAK
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: glass breaks (3D; a shot's hole quieter and higher than a pane shattering) - < 0.6 s

items.name: DEBRIS
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: rubble (3D): a breakable block broken, a wall coming down, a crumble platform shaking and falling - < 0.85 s

items.name: DASH_BOUNCE
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: your dash bounced off a wall: a springy thud - < 0.3 s

items.name: GRAPPLE_RELEASE
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a grapple let go (yours, or someone's in 3D) - < 0.25 s

items.name: TELEPORT
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a teleporter (yours; someone else's at both ends, in 3D) - < 0.7 s

items.name: SPLASH
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a splash into a liquid (and quieter, higher, out of it; yours and others') - < 0.6 s

items.name: SPAWN
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: you respawned: a soft whoosh in - < 0.6 s

items.name: LOW_HEALTH
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: your health fell under the low-health line: a heartbeat - < 0.5 s

items.name: GOAL
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: ball: a goal, a stadium horn (lower when it's against your side) - < 1.35 s

items.name: BALL_KICK
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: ball: the ball struck (a kick, a push, a hard bounce; 3D, louder the harder) - short, < 0.25 s

items.name: CHAT
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: someone else's chat message: a soft blip (higher and louder when it names you) - very short, < 0.15 s

items.name: VOTE
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a vote was called - < 0.5 s

items.name: MATCH_FOUND
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: ranked: the queue found your match - < 0.75 s

items.name: UI_CLICK
items.desc: DEFAULT kit: a menu click (any button, toggle, arrow or list) - very short, < 0.05 s

items.name: ARM

items.name: BOMB_PACK

items.name: BOMB

items.name: CART
items.desc: the payload cart: origin on the track under its middle, front (-Z) the way it is pushed. Materials team* = the pushing team (white = that colour; grey when neutral), metal* / accent* / glow* = the map's colours

items.name: GATE
items.desc: a payload checkpoint: origin on the track, -Z the cart's way, posts either side (x +-1.8). Materials team* = grey, the attackers' colour once the cart has reached it

items.name: HOOK_ARM
items.desc: every player's left arm with the grapple launcher (first and third person): origin at the left shoulder, reaching along -Z (turned with the aim, scaled with the body); the rope leaves the barrel's mouth at (0, 0.07, -0.66). Materials team* = the team colour (first person: your accent colour), metal* drawn as authored

items.name: HOOK
items.desc: the grapple's claw: origin where the rope ties on, prongs toward -Z; sits in the launcher's barrel at (0, 0.07, -0.59) of HOOK_ARM, and flies out to the hook point, turned along the rope. Materials metal* drawn as authored
